title: Early Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 month Contract)
description:
Job Type: Internal Secondment 
Work Model: Hybrid 
Reference code: 130060   
Primary Location: Montreal, QC  
All Available Locations: Montreal, QC; Fredericton, NB; Halifax, NS; Ottawa, ON
 Our Purpose
 At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.
Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
--
 Within the Culture and People Office (CPO), our goal is to have every one of our people say of their achievements with clients and the firm, “I only could have done it at Deloitte.”  In this Specialist (Early Talent Acquisition) role, you’ll have the opportunity to bring this value proposition to life and make an impact that matters. Working as part of our Early Talent team, you’ll have an opportunity to make an impact in shaping our firm of the future, starting with our most important assets, our people.
  What will your typical day look like?
 We are seeking bright, passionate professionals who excel at solving big problems and seizing significant opportunities.  In this role, your curiosity, customer-centricity, and growth mindset will drive innovative programs that align with our business, culture, and people priorities.  You’ll embrace the power of AI to make work better for humans and humans better for work, while seamlessly transitioning between strategic planning and hands-on execution, providing insightful advice and practical solutions. Your deep business acumen will enable you to thrive in our fast-paced environment, where you can experiment with new ideas and collaborate effectively with a dynamic team.
 What you will do:
 Attract, assess and hire on campus to fill full-time, internship and co-op positions within your assigned market(s).
Act as primary recruiting point of contact at target educational institutions within your market and for assigned client portfolio; develop and maintain relationships with students, career centers, student clubs, faculty and internal business partners in Talent Advisory, Programs & Events and Talent Services.
Work with the Campus Recruitment Team to recruit in accordance with national guidelines and the law and to address the firm’s position at strategic schools to ensure a consistent recruiting approach comparable to those of other top-rated firms.
Assist in the planning and execution of a variety of campus event, Deloitte-hosted conferences, case, office visits etc.  
Actively recruit internal client serving volunteers to represent Deloitte on campus. Train clients and provide subject matter expertise on related recruitment procedures, roles and on-campus expectations.
Implement sourcing strategies to identify talented candidates, meeting diversity initiatives.
Maintain a constant and steady focus on the assigned local market and target school, sharing competitive intelligence to key stakeholders.
Partner with Early Talent Analysts and others to deliver the highest level of candidate care
Utilize firm standard tools to capture all recruiting and hiring activity. Also assist in the collection of new hire documentation.
Develop specific branded material for specific area and practice needs. Liaise with national marketing and branding for strategy and messaging.
Demonstrates flexibility and willingness to travel to all campus locations as well as work in excess of standard hours when necessary. Some weekends and evenings are required.
Assist with Social Media initiatives as needed.
About the team
 The Early Talent Acquisition team is dedicated to delivering top intern/co-op talent to our stakeholders and an exceptional candidate experience to the students we engage with. We collaborate with internal clients and across Culture & People Office to provide strategic insights that facilitate the development of tailored recruitment strategies, targeted events and other programs to that position Deloitte as Category of One. The team advises on, implements, and executes the recruiting strategy, providing full-lifecycle recruitment support. You will work alongside other Specialists and Analysts across the country on national large-scale programs to smaller, local targeted events at tier one schools.
Enough about us, let’s talk about you
 In this role the expected qualifications are:
 Bachelor’s degree with 3-5 years of relevant Campus Recruitment and Human Resources experience
Understanding of how to ability to attract and retain talent, and understanding of the firm and business, building relationship.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment
Exceptional organization, planning, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables
Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $58,000 - $96,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth.  Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.
 Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.
 Be yourself, and more.
We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You shape how we make impact.
Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be
Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.
We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours
 At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.
 We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca  for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).
 By applying to this job you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We’ve designed these standards to provide our clients with a consistent and exceptional Deloitte experience globally.
 Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship with Indigenous communities in our shared goal of reconciliation and environmental sustainability.

title: Gameplay Programmer (Intern)
description:
The Studio
Compulsion Games is a first-party game studio and subsidiary of Microsoft's Xbox Game Studios, located in Montreal, Canada.
Founded by industry veterans, we have a human-first culture where we trust and respect each
other, with shared love and passion for our craft. Since our inception in 2009, we've been dedicated to crafting
extraordinary games that delve into the depths of human experience. Our titles, such as Contrast, We Happy Few and South of Midnight have garnered acclaim for their distinctive art, immersive music, rich world-building, and captivating narratives.

We aim to create characters with compelling, human flaws and narratives that explore heavy themes with care and empathy. Our storytelling typically has a healthy dose of darkness and comedy
thrown in for good measure.

Our Culture
Compulsion Games is a quality-led studio with a humble team that enjoys experimenting with an artistic
approach to making games. We are interested in people who are drawn to our core values of trust, autonomy, harmony, and craftsmanship and share our vision of a studio built around them. As a team, we do not want to grow too big to stay true to these values, as they don't scale well.

Our team is passionately committed to both diversity and accessibility, core values throughout the Xbox Game Studios group. We care deeply about our team and their well-being, so you'd be joining a close-knit group of creative people.

The Need
We're looking to add a talented Gameplay Programmer to our human-sized programming community, to help develop gameplay systems and ingredients while being an active and important member of our multidisciplinary feature teams. We need a programmer who is eager to contribute to the overall gameplay experience of our players.

TheRole
Our games are made using Unreal Engine, previous experience with UE and C++ is a bonus, but not required. Previous game projects that showcase your expertise and interest in video games are a bonus, but not a requirement. We would like someone who is comfortable communicating and working directly with artists, writers, and designers to develop gameplay features and systems such as player interaction, character
behavior, game elements, 3C, AI or game progression.

True to our core values of trust and autonomy, we will not dictate your mandates but instead will empower
you to follow your interest and explore topics that excite you. Your lead and the other programmers will
be there to support and advise you in this endeavor.

Important
This is a paid internship
Interns and their mentors to work in-person in the Montreal studio

Responsibilities
You will develop features for our next game in the Unreal Engine
You will write C/C++ code that will shape the vision of the game

Qualifications
You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree granting program or higher
You must be available for a full-time paid internship winter 2025 semester
You are passionate about video games
You are familiar with an object-oriented programming (OOP) language, ideally C++
You are comfortable communicating with a team of different disciplines
You are able to communicate in verbal and written form in English
This is a full-time position, with a salary, based in our Downtown Montreal location, by Atwater Metro station. We are only considering students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program. Applicants must be legally
authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis during the internship (January 2025 - May 2025). Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

At PwC, our Operations & Procurement consulting practice partners with clients across industries to enhance their core operations, supply chain, and procurement functions. title: Junior Mainframe CICS System Programmer
description:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward - always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.
The Role
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented bilingual Junior Mainframe CICS System Programmer to join our team. In this role, the candidate will work closely with senior system programmers to support and maintain our subsystems environment. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in mainframe systems with hands-on experience, structured training and mentorship.
The CICS is part of the subsystems on Mainframe and we are dedicated to work in a strategic outsourcing client that permits a constant evolution in skills including security.
As a Junior Mainframe CICS System Programmer you will learn the essential technical and analytical skills required to ensure the smooth operation of the relational database management system. IBM CICS is one of the most powerful, reliable, and scalable database platforms for mainframe. If you are passionate about technology, love problem-solving, and thrive in a dynamic working environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you.
Responsibilities:
Assist with the administration, maintenance, and optimization of CICS on the mainframe platform
Learn to monitor and troubleshoot database performance issues to ensure maximum efficiency
Collaborate with senior DBAs and stakeholders to support application development and database design processes
Perform database back-up and recovery tasks under guidance
Participate in training and development programmes to build expertise in CICS and Mainframe environments
Documents CICS processes, configurations and troubleshooting steps
Raise and manage change records using change request tool
Investigate and resolve CICS related incidents and problems, ensuring updating ticket records and closed in a timely manner.
Train for on-call rotation support 24/7
Who You Are
Requirements:
A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Up to 3 years of experience-internships, co-ops, or academic projects count!
Interest in mainframe systems and enterprise technology
A problem-solving mindset and eagerness to tackle technical challenges
Basic understanding of database concepts
Strong communication skills-both written and verbal
French language proficiency is required
A team-first attitude and openness to feedback
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment
(This position requires the employee to work on a regular basis with Kyndryl stakeholders located in other Canadian provinces, the United States, or internationally where English is the common language, making knowledge of the English language a requirement for this position in addition to fluency in French.)
Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it's how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we're not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you - and everyone next to you - the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That's the Kyndryl Way.
What You Can Expect
As a graduate or an intern, Kyndryl is a great place to kickstart your career. You will contribute to our business from day one and get access to some incredible learning opportunities to build your skills for your future. You'll also collaborate with global teams, take advantage of mentorship opportunities and get involved in volunteer community activities - all in a dynamic, start up atmosphere, filled with industry experts.
Get Referred!
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked 'How Did You Hear About Us' during the application process, select 'Employee Referral' and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Student, ESG Communications
description:
Gildan is leading the way in apparel manufacturing, with a strong portfolio of brands, including Gildan®, American Apparel®, Comfort Colors®, GOLDTOE®, and Peds®. We’ve spent the last four decades perfecting the art of respectful apparel making, and the last 20 years implementing sustainable initiatives throughout our business.
Founded in Canada, we now operate out of roughly 30 locations worldwide across 12 countries and sell our products in 60+ markets globally with $3 billion in sales. Together with more than 45,000 employees, we are united in our vision of Making Apparel Better®. Discover the full scale of Gildan and prepare to be surprised at gildancorp.com.

Gildan’s ESG & Communications team is looking for a motivated individual to support the development and launch of the 2025 ESG Report, with a strong focus on ESG rankings and ratings that form a key part of the Company’s disclosure and communications. This role offers hands-on experience in sustainability communications, stakeholder engagement, and ESG disclosure practices within a leading apparel manufacturer known for its vertical integration, strong sustainability commitments, and global presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia.
 You will gain valuable exposure to how a publicly traded company (NYSE & TSX) manages sustainability reporting and strategy, while contributing to high-visibility projects that directly impact Gildan’s reputation and transparency with investors, employees, customers, and global stakeholders. Through this role, you’ll help shape the Company’s narrative on ESG performance and support initiatives that drive its sustainability roadmap.
 The role
Assist in drafting, revising, and translating ESG report content to align with Gildan’s brand voice, disclosure standards, and reporting frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD, SDGs).
Coordinate the collection and integration of ESG data and narratives from internal teams across global operations.
Support the creation of visuals, case studies, and storytelling elements to enhance the impact of the ESG Report.
Help review ESG questionnaires (e.g., CDP, CSA, MSCI, Sustainalytics) to ensure consistency across disclosures.
Contribute to internal and external communication materials (press releases, web content, employee updates) linked to the ESG Report launch.
Monitor best practices in corporate sustainability communications and recommend innovative approaches.
The requirements
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Communications, Public Relations, Sustainability, Environmental Studies, or a related field.
Knowledge of ESG and sustainability reporting standards and frameworks (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, SDGs, CDP) is required.
Hands-on experience drafting or editing reports, content creation, communications, or ESG reporting content (internships, academic projects, or professional experience).
Exposure to ESG strategy, corporate reporting processes, or environmental/social impact analysis is preferred.
Bilingual in English and French (Spanish is an asset).
Excellent writing, editing, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data organization, basic analysis, and integration into reporting) and other MS Office tools.
Strong research and analytical abilities.
Creative thinker with an eye for detail.
Team player with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex information into clear, engaging content.
This position requires proficiency in a language other than French to support customers, employees or markets located outside the province of Quebec or requiring services in a language other than French – mainly English.

title: Internship - Airworthiness, ANB
description:
THE ORGANIZATIONAL SETTING
The Air Navigation Bureau (ANB) is responsible for providing technical guidance to the Air Navigation Commission (ANC), the Council, and the Assembly. ANB provides technical expertise in aviation-related disciplines to States, industry, and all elements of the organization. The Bureau is also responsible for maintaining and implementing the Global Aviation Safety Plan (GASP) and Global Air Navigation Plan (GANP), including its aviation system block upgrades and producing yearly safety and air navigation status reports. The Bureau develops technical studies and proposals for Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) and Procedures for Air Navigation Services (PANS) for further processing by the governing bodies of ICAO. The Bureau also develops related procedures and guidance material. The Bureau also manages the Universal Safety Oversight Audit Programme (USOAP) and Continuous Monitoring Approach that monitors all States on a continuous basis.
The Intern will join the Operational Safety (OPS) Section of ANB, Specifically, they will assist in the implementation of the airworthiness related Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) of Annex 1 - Personnel Licensing, Annex 6 - Operation of Aircraft, Parts I, II, III and IV; Annex 8 - Airworthiness of Aircraft.  They will also carry out additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Supervisor and collaborate closely with other Technical Officers in the Bureau and with Regional Offices for all airworthiness OPS-related matters.
This internship provides an opportunity for a qualified student or recent graduate to gain valuable experience in international civil aviation, with a particular focus on airworthiness standards and regulatory frameworks under Annex 8.
  TERMS OF REFERENCE
Under general guidance of the Chief of OPS and the Technical officer airworthiness, the intern will assist the OPS Section of the ANB with tasks related to the development, implementation, and monitoring of airworthiness related SARPs of Annexes 6 and 8, and related guidance material: 
Conduct research on a diverse range of assigned issues in aircraft airworthiness, and other area(s) of specialization using multiple research sources; select relevant material, analyse information and present findings for internal review.
Assist technical officer airworthiness in the review of documents, identify important issues, similarities and inconsistencies, etc.
Assist in the preparation of drafts of background papers, studies, reports, and other documents on airworthiness subjects.
Support the review and update of ICAO SARPs and guidance materials related to Annexes 6 and 8.
Assist Technical Officer in supporting the Assembly, working groups and other bodies.  etc.
Assist in preparation of draft replies to correspondence from States, other international organizations and individuals.
Assist in the preparation of technical papers, reports, and presentations for panels, working groups, and the Airworthiness Panel (AIRP).
Perform other related duties, as assigned.
  QUALIFICATIONS
Education
At the time of application, candidates are required to have completed or be enrolled in a degree programme (first-level university degree or higher) in a field of study related to engineering. 
Applicants pursuing studies in countries where higher education is not divided into undergraduate and graduate stages should have completed at least four years of full-time studies at a university or equivalent institution towards the completion of a degree.
  Languages
Essential
Fluent reading, writing and speaking abilities in English.
Desirable
A working knowledge of any other language of the Organization (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish).

  OTHER
Excellent research, writing, and communication skills in English.
Ability to work independently and as part of a diverse team. 
Strong interest in aviation regulation, international standards, and safety oversight
  CONDITIONS OF INTERNSHIP

Interns are not paid. All costs related to travel, insurance, accommodation, and living expenses must be borne by the intern.

The duration of the internship is between three to six months. The intern is expected to work five days a week, on a full-time basis. 

Interns shall not be eligible to be engaged in any other form of employment within ICAO during the period of internship and shall not be eligible to apply for or be appointed to any post in the Secretariat or be contracted for any other remunerated employment with ICAO for the six months immediately following the end of their internship.

You are required to have a work permit  in Canada as a full-term intern.

  HOW TO APPLY
  Interested candidates must complete an on-line application form and attach a recommendation letter from the educational institution. To apply, please visit ICAO's e-Recruitment website at: https://careers-new.icao.int.

  NOTICE TO CANDIDATES
  ICAO does NOT charge any fees or request money from candidates at any stage of the selection process, nor does it concern itself with bank account details of applicants. Requests of this nature allegedly made on behalf of ICAO are fraudulent and should be disregarded.

The successful People and Culture Business Partner will act as an employee champion and change agent while assessing and anticipating People and Culture-related needs. The People and Culture Business Partner also formulates partnerships across the People and Culture function to deliver value-added services to management and employees that reflect the business objectives of the organization.

Acts as the point of contact and sounding board for managers, working with Leadership, developing a Communication Strategy and Engagement Strategy for the whole company.
Determines the course of action for Diversity and Inclusion requirements.
Develop a standardized and consistent Onboarding and Orientation program for all employees at all worksites in alignment with brand and Standard Operating Procedures.
Engineer a Training Roadmap based on compliance audit and gaps; Design a Coaching program and Development plan for succession in correlation with training.
Conducts weekly meetings with respective business units.

Develops contract terms for new hires, promotions, and transfers.
Assists international employees with expatriate assignments and related P&C matters.

Advanced degree in Human Resources Management, Organization Development, or Business preferred.
PHR or SPHR Certification is strongly preferred.
5+ years of working experience in an HR Generalist capacity or HR Business Partner capacity, specifically professional development, training, and employee relations.

Working in an HR function within a Manufacturing facility is a plus.

Familiarity with state and federal employment laws and HR best practices in operations is a necessity for key areas, for example, in the areas of recruitment, compensation and benefits, and training and development.

Advanced Microsoft Office experience, specifically Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

1+ years of experience in UX design, including internships or related projects.
Experience with user research and usability testing
Proficiency in design tools with industry standard design tools e.g. Figma is an asset
 Preferred Skills

Understanding of responsive design and the ability to prototype interactive user interfaces.

title: Stage hiver 2026 - Comptabilite / 2026 winter Internship - accounting (Mirabel, QC)
description:
Nous sommes des pionniers. Nous avons été les premiers à franchir le mur du son et à concevoir le premier scooter de l’espace fonctionnel. Nous avons pris part à la première mission de la NASA sur la Lune et nous avons mis en marché des systèmes de rotors basculants évolués. Aujourd’hui, nous façonnons l’avenir de la mobilité sur demande. Les employés de Bell sont fiers de travailler pour une entreprise emblématique, regroupant de grands talents, qui produit en peu de temps des appareils à décollage vertical novateurs et recherchés.
Les stagiaires se verront assigner des tâches à la hauteur de leurs compétences techniques et de leur capacité d’analyse démontrée pour analyser des opérations financières et préparer les rapports connexes. Les stagiaires auront l’occasion de mettre leurs connaissances en pratique, de contribuer au succès de l’entreprise et de se familiariser avec le secteur de l’aviation.
Le stagiaire en finances relèvera du superviseur finances, qui sera aussi son mentor,et devra réaliser différentes tâches en comptabilité et en finances. Ce stage est conçu pour élargir et perfectionner les compétences en comptabilité et en finances dans un milieu de travail réel.
 TÂCHES ASSOCIÉES AU STAGE :
Les rôles et les responsabilités comprennent, sans s’y limiter :

• Participation à la fermeture mensuelle des comptes ainsi qu’à la préparation des rapports financiers
• Réalisation de projets de comptes fournisseurs, gestion des problèmes liés à la réception des marchandises et proposition de mesures correctives.
• Participation à la gestion de trésorerie et à la préparation des prévisions.
• Conciliation détaillée interentreprises des pièces de rechange
• Exécution d’analyses diverses du bilan.
• Collaboration étroite avec les services responsables des comptes clients, des comptes fournisseurs et du crédit.
• Suivi des rapports SOX (Sarbanes Oxley) et introduction à la vérification interne 
• Réalisation de projets particuliers
• Préparation des rapports pour la direction.
***
We are pioneers. We were the first to break the sound barrier and design the first functional jetpack. We were aboard NASA’s first lunar mission and brought advanced tiltrotor systems to market. Today, we are defining the future of on-demand mobility. At Bell, we are proud to be an iconic company with superb talent, rapidly creating novel and coveted vertical lift experiences. 
Interns are assigned tasks based on their technical proficiency and demonstrated analytical skills to report and analyze financial transactions. This internship will providestudents with real world assignments that bring value to the business and high level exposure to the aviation industry. The finance intern will work under the mentorship and direction of the Finance supervisor to carry out various accounting and finance duties. This internship is designed as an opportunity to develop and enhance accounting and finance skills in a real world working environment.
SPECIFIC DUTIES:
Roles and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Month-end closing process and financial reporting support
• Perform accounts payables projects, manage goods and receipts issues and proposed corrective actions
• Assist with cash management and forecasting process
• Perform detailed intercompany reconciiation for spares parts
• Perform miscelleaneous Balance sheet analysis
• Work closely with accounts receivable, accounts payable and credit departments
• Perform SOX (Sarbanes Oxley)monitoring and testing control duties
• Work on special projects as assigned
• Preparing management presentation reports
Exigences
• Inscription à  un baccalauréat en compatibilité ou dans un domaine connexe
• Solides aptitudes de communication 
• Très bonne connaissance des principes comptables généralement reconnus
• Bonne compréhension des logiciels Microsoft (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
• Aucune expérience requise. Un stage antérieur en comptabilité serait un atout
• La connaissance de SAP serait un atout
Avantages
Possibilité d'horaire flexible;
Cohorte d'environ 30 stagiaires par session sur tout le site de Bell à Mirabel ;
Salaire compétitif
Cafétéria sur place;
Possibilité d'extension
Projets et défis stimulants.
 Ne ratez pas votre chance de vous joindre à un milieu diversifié et inclusif qui favorise un sentiment d’appartenance. En tant que membre de notre effectif mondial, vous collaborerez avec des équipes dévouées et enthousiastes, dont les différences d’expériences, d’antécédents et d’idées et une solide passion pour nos produits nous permettent d’aller au-delà du vol.
 Bell Textron Canada Ltée adhère aux principes d’équité en matière d’emploi.
***
• Enrollment in a technic or Bachelor’s level program in Accounting/Finance or other related field
• Solid communication skills
• Solid academic track record
• Sound knowledge of general accounting principles
• Good understanding of Microsoft suite (excel, word, PowerPoint, etc)
• No previous experience required. Previous finance or accounting internships a plus
• Knowledge of SAP a plus
 Benefits
Possibility of flexible hours;
Cohort of approximately 30 interns per session throughout the Bell site;
Competitive salary
On-site cafeteria;
Possibility of extension
Challenging projects and challenges.
 Don’t miss the chance to join a diverse, inclusive environment where you feel a sense of belonging. As a member of our global workforce, you will collaborate with dedicated, enthusiastic teams where unique experiences, backgrounds and ideas combined with a strong passion for our products take us above and beyond flight.
 Bell Textron Canada Ltee adheres to the principles of Employment Equity.

Location: Montreal, QC
Looking for an internship in fashion? You have the desire to gain valuable experience in e-commerce?
We invite you to apply for this E-commerce internship - join us in contributing to our ongoing success!
What you will do.
As an E-commerce Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in the dynamic world of online retail. This internship is designed to give you exposure to the key elements of e-commerce operations - from online merchandising to sales performance and digital marketing. Under the guidance of our e-commerce team, you will actively contribute to the growth and success of our online business.
More specifically, your tasks include (but are not limited to):
Assist in uploading and maintaining product listings, ensuring accuracy in product descriptions, images, and pricing.
Analyze website performance metrics, such as conversion rates, traffic, and product sell-through, and prepare summary reports.
Help optimize product presentation by reviewing visual content and ensuring alignment with brand standards.
Conduct competitive research to identify trends, pricing strategies, and assortment opportunities.
Assist in preparing creative briefs and ensuring marketing content aligns with e-commerce guidelines.
Provide general support to the e-commerce team with daily administrative and operational tasks.
Who you are.
What matters most to us is your curiosity, attention to detail, and passion for e-commerce and fashion! You are eager to learn how digital retail operates behind the scenes and motivated to make a real impact on our online performance.
Additionally, we are looking for the following:
Currently studying or recently graduated in E-commerce, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
Strong computer skills, especially in Excel and Google Sheets; familiarity with e-commerce platforms is a plus.
Understanding of digital trends, online shopping behavior, or website analytics is an asset.
Highly organized, analytical, and able to manage multiple priorities.
Strong communication skills in French and English.
A team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
What we offer.
Exposure to the full e-commerce lifecycle - from product upload to post-sale analysis.
Mentorship from experienced digital retail professionals.
Employee discounts on our latest collections.
Opportunities for skill development and career growth within BESTSELLE
Looking forward to meeting you!
BESTSELLER is an international fashion company with brands such as JACK and JONES, VERO MODA, ONLY and JACK & JONES. BESTSELLER operates both its own chains / stores as well as we have a large number of retailers on the market. As an employee of BESTSELLER, you become part of our family. We offer a developing and exciting workplace with a high pace where we all work together towards common goals. Our philosophy and our values are important to us, we work hard and strive to be the best but always in a humble way. BESTSELLER Canada began in 2004 and currently works with eight of our brands. JACK & JONES is our sole retail presence in Canada, while VERO MODA, ONLY, ONLY & SONS, SELECTED FEMME/HOMME, PRODUKT, NOISY MAY and JACQUELINE DE YOUNG are part of our wholesale distribution. Our office in Montreal is the centre of BESTSELLER's North American operations and the workplace of almost 100 of our colleagues. Overall, BESTSELLER Canada has approximately 600 colleagues, including our distribution centre and almost 50 JACK & JONES stores.

title: Pharmacist
description:
Job Description 
Description of position:
Performs direct patient care; dispenses prescription medication and educates patients. Practices to the fullest extent of the expanded scope of pharmacy practice permitted by provincial regulations.

Daily tasks and responsibilities:
Dispenses prescription medications and applies appropriate auxiliary labels.
Checks prescriptions and over the counter medications for therapeutic appropriateness including but not limited to drug interactions, allergies, contraindications, dose, frequency, and dosage form.
Verifies prescriptions and refills with physicians by phone as needed and takes verbal prescriptions. Selects therapeutic substitutions when appropriate.
Oversees the collection of patient medical history and maintenance of the confidential computer record.
Collaborates with other health care professionals as necessary to identify and resolve drug therapy problems. Educates patients on proper medication usage. Provides prompt and courteous patient care. Answers patient questions about over-the-counter medication and product location. Preserves patient confidentiality.
Works collaboratively with Registered Technician to ensure appropriate allocation of work tasks.
Recruits patients for and conducts health and wellness clinics and documents interventions where permitted by provincial regulations.
Adapts, extends, and modifies prescriptions as well as performs specific acts under the delegation or collaboration of a prescriber to the extent permitted by provincial regulations.
Administers medications to patients by injection where permitted by provincial regulations
Conducts full medication reviews, including but not limited to best possible medication histories and medication reconciliation and participates in medication therapy management and does patient follow-up to the extent permitted by provincial regulations
Orders and communicates laboratory tests to the extent permitted by provincial regulations.
Participates in a culture of patient safety by focusing on practices that reduce and eliminate prescription incidents as well as reporting and properly managing those incidents that do occur.
Maintains professional competence through participation in a variety of continuing education initiatives and maintains required certifications in good standing.
Follows Costco Pharmacy's policies, systems and procedure standards. Follows safety and security procedures.
Acts as Pharmacist-In-Charge in the absence of the pharmacy manager ensuring smooth operation in the dispensary and supervises pharmacy interns and students.

Assists with other assigned duties as necessary

Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
 About the SAP Internship Experience Program 
 The SAP Internship Experience Program is SAP's global, strategic, paid internship program that provides university students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. 
 Three reasons to intern at SAP 
  Culture of collaboration:meet with mentors, make new friends across the globe and create a thriving personal network. 
Project-driven experience:gain cross-functional skills from our virtual and in-person learning sessions, diverse subject matter experts, and project deliverables. 
Gain visibility:with SAP Internship Experience Program in your title, you'll have a global network of SAP leaders, entrepreneurs and career development opportunities at your fingertips. 
 What you'll do 
 Position title: SAP iXp Intern - AI & Data Engineer Foundation Model
Location: Montreal, QC
Expected start date: October 2025 (8 months)
  Collaborate with Applied AI Researchers and AI Engineers to support data needs for various research projects.
Develop opportunities to shape and have an influential impact on the future of SAP's AI portfolio and its suite of enterprise software products.
Work with cloud platforms for data processing, data lakes, and model training providers.
Gain hands-on experiences with Python, Machine Learning/Deep Learning libraries & Knowledge Graphs.
Develop and maintain data pipelines for structured data powering the training of Foundational Models for Tabular Data.
Build innovative tools to enrich and scale the training of large machine models on enterprise software data
 What you bring 
 We're looking for someone who takes initiative, perseveres, and stay curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.
  Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field.  
Good communication and teamwork abilities. 
Strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms and Deep Learning pre-training & fine-tuning techniques, particularly in the context of structured data. 
Experience in Python for Data Science and experience with Machine Learning framework for Deep Learning 
Experience with cloud-based Data Lakes & data processing pipeline on large volumes of data (e.g., Azure ML, Databricks, Apache Spark). 
Knowledge or experience working with SAP ERP Software (such as S/4HANA or ECC) and SAP BTP is a plus.  
Knowledge of version control systems like Git and familiar with using Unix or windows-based command lines. 
Bachelor's or Master's degree (ongoing or recently completed) 
 Meet your team 
 Language foundational models, like LLMs, have been pivotal in driving generalization across various NLP tasks. Our SAP Foundation Model Team for structured data aims to establish a centralized foundation with graph and generative intelligence that can effectively support cross-SAP AI use cases, particularly for tabular AI tasks.  
 The success of this foundation model depends heavily on several factors, including the quality, type, format, volume, and scheduling of the pre-training data. This makes the data pipeline and overall data strategy critical to its success. 
  If you have less than three years' professional experience, you'll be part of SAP Next Gen. 
  SAP Next Gen connects curious, ambitious, team-oriented students and early talent to SAP'sglobal community of innovators, peers, and leaders. 
  With access to hands-on experiences that sharpen skills, and the wisdomof the leaders shaping what's next, knowledge becomes impact and mentors become allies. 
  SAP Next Gen doesn't just prepare you for the future, it nurtures your talents and your drive so that you can create it with us, together. 
 Bring out your best
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  

We win with inclusion
 SAP's culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone - regardless of background - feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. Excellente opportunité pour développer sa carrière dans l’une des top entreprise Aéronautique a Montréal !
À propos du poste :
Nous recherchons un(e) Planificateur(trice) de Production – Analyste Chaîne d’Approvisionnement organisé(e) et analytique pour rejoindre notre équipe de fabrication. Ce rôle est essentiel pour assurer le séquencement efficace des matières premières et leur flux dans la fabrication de pièces rotatives de haute précision telles que turbines, pales, rotors et diffuseurs. Le ou la candidat(e) retenu(e) jouera un rôle clé dans l’alignement des horaires de production avec les besoins des différents centres internes et clients du marché secondaire.
Responsabilités principales :
Planification et Séquencement des Matériaux :
Assurer le séquencement adéquat des matières premières pour une ligne de fabrication spécifique afin de respecter les objectifs de production et les délais de livraison.
Coordination de la Production :
Aligner les plans du centre de fabrication avec les horaires de plusieurs centres de production et clients.
Gestion des Problèmes :
Analyser et répondre aux changements de conception ou aux problèmes de qualité pouvant affecter le séquencement de production. Ajuster les plans pour minimiser les perturbations.
Opérations Quotidiennes :
Utiliser des outils tels qu’Excel et SAP pour gérer et mettre à jour les horaires de production.
Prioriser les lancements de pièces et les inspections.
Maintenir des dates de promesse précises et s’assurer que les lignes de production sont à jour.
Collaboration et Communication :
Participer aux réunions quotidiennes de production avec les chefs d’équipe et les superviseurs.
Maintenir un haut niveau de communication par appels et courriels pour coordonner avec les parties prenantes internes.

Formation en génie industriel, opérations, logistique ou administration des affaires.
Diplôme universitaire ou technique dans un domaine pertinent.
Excellentes compétences en communication requises.
0 à 2 ans d’expérience avec un stage, ou 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en opérations, planification ou logistique.
Excellent opportunity to grow your career in one of the leading Aerospace companies in Montreal!

We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Production Planner – Supply Chain Analyst to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will play a key role in aligning production schedules with the demands of various internal stakeholders and aftermarket customers.
Key Responsibilities:
Material Sequencing & Planning:
Ensure raw materials are properly sequenced for a specific manufacturing line to meet production targets and delivery schedules.
Production Coordination:
Align fabrication center plans with the schedules of multiple production and customer centers.
Issue Management:
Analyze and respond to design changes or quality issues that may impact production sequencing. Adjust plans to minimize disruptions.
Daily Operations:
Use tools such as Excel and SAP to manage and update production schedules.
Prioritize part releases and inspections.
Maintain accurate promise dates and ensure production lines are up to date.
Collaboration & Communication:
Participate in daily production meetings with team leads and supervisors.
Maintain high levels of communication via calls and emails to coordinate with internal stakeholders.
Qualifications:
Experience in Industrial Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or Business Administration.
Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma in a relevant field.
Excellent communication skills required.
0–2 years of experience with internship experience, or 2–5 years of experience in operations, planning, or logistics.

description:
Senior Consultant, Greenhouse Gas & Climate Strategy
Location: Hybrid – Kitchener, Ontario Office (531 Wellington Street North, Kitchener, ON N2H 5L6)
AET Group is growing and we’re looking for a Senior Consultant who’s ready to lead the charge in shaping the future of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) and Climate Strategy consulting in Canada.
This is more than a consulting role it is an opportunity to help build and grow a service area that’s driving measurable climate impact. You’ll combine technical expertise, project leadership, and strategic vision to deliver high-impact solutions and mentor others as we expand our sustainability services.
Why This Role Stands Out
Build Something Meaningful – Take a leading role in expanding our GHG and Climate Strategy division, shaping its vision and influence across Canada.
Lead with Purpose – Deliver technical excellence while guiding sustainability journeys for organizations working toward net-zero goals.
Grow as a Leader – Mentor emerging professionals, lead high-impact projects, and strengthen client partnerships.
Collaborate with Experts – Join a multi-disciplinary team recognized for environmental innovation, integrity, and excellence.
What You’ll Be Doing
Technical Leadership & Delivery - You’ll help organizations move from measuring their impact to making meaningful change.
Lead and deliver high-impact sustainability projects, including:
GHG inventories, quantifications, and verifications
GHG reduction project planning and implementation
Organizational sustainability strategies and stakeholder engagement
Lifecycle assessments and strategic sustainability reporting
Oversee AET’s Accredited Validation and Verification Program, preparing for and responding to SCC assessments
Support sustainability disclosures, including materiality assessments and climate scenario analysis
Project Management & Coordination - You’ll be the steady hand ensuring projects run smoothly, efficiently, and successfully.
Lead project kick-off meetings, team coordination, and client communication
Manage budgets, schedules, and deliverables across multiple projects
Perform data analysis, QA/QC, and reporting to ensure quality outcomes
Maintain clear communication with all stakeholders and handle administrative tasks including cost accounting and invoicing
Business Development & Outreach - You’ll help shape AET’s growth strategy and bring in meaningful, mission-aligned work.
Identify new opportunities through RFPs and RFQs
Lead proposal writing and client outreach
Represent AET at industry events and build partnerships that expand our impact
Mentorship & Team Growth - You’ll help develop the next generation of climate professionals while building a respected practice area.
Mentor and coach emerging professionals in GHG and sustainability
Support hiring and training initiatives
Present findings to clients and represent AET at conferences and workshops
What You'll Bring

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Studies, Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent
7–10 years of experience leading GHG and Sustainability project
Proven expertise quantifying and verifying GHG emissions data for inventories and offset projects
Technical Knowledge
Strong understanding of ISO 14064 standards and related GHG protocols (GHG Protocol, IPCC, CDM)
Experience with Canadian regulatory programs (GHGRP, OBPS, TIER, EPS
Familiar with U.S. and international compliance programs (CARB, etc.)
Skills & Abilities
Advanced Microsoft Excel and Office skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
Self-motivated, resourceful, and independent
Strong research and analytical abilities for timely, high-quality deliverables
Valid driver’s license
Preferred Assets
Knowledge of ESG frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD)
Training in ISO 14001 & 45001 standards
Experience with life cycle assessments, GHG reduction planning, and carbon offset projects
Environmental auditing and site visit experience
Business development and proposal preparation experience
Multidisciplinary background in energy, water, and waste management
Who We Are
AET Group is one of Canada’s top environmental employers, delivering sustainable, practical solutions for over 25 years. From audits to air quality, waste to water, our team is united by one mission: to make a measurable difference.
We value Integrity, Excellence, Respect, and Sustainable Solutions and we’re proud to be a company where your leadership shapes the path forward.
Ready to Grow With Us?
Apply today and help us build a more sustainable future. Apply at: www.aet98.com or by emailing a coverletter and resume to: aethr@aet98.com

title: Consultant
description:
Consultant I #2025-12
COMPANY:  Nautilus Environmental Company Inc.
LOCATION:  Calgary, AB or Cambridge, ON
STATUS:  Permanent, full-time (2 positions)
ANTICIPATED START DATE:  November 2025 
DESCRIPTION: Are you a motivated and detail-oriented environmental professional looking for your next challenge in environmental consulting? We are currently seeking candidates to fill a senior Consultant position in our Ecotoxicology Laboratory. In this role, you will apply your knowledge and skills in ecotoxicity testing to generate client-specific data and provide novel solutions to real-time applied challenges faced by industry, government, and municipalities. As a Consultant, you will communicate directly with clients to be the lead in designing, analyzing, and interpreting projects tailored to the client’s needs. You will also act as a liaison between Nautilus clients, the Laboratory Managers and Senior Management.  
ABOUT US: Nautilus operates three ecotoxicity laboratories in Canada, offering freshwater and marine aquatic toxicity testing, sediment and soil toxicity testing, biodegradability tests, and toxicity investigations and consulting services. Our services are tailored to meet the needs of the mining, pulp and paper, municipal wastewater, iron and steel, electrical power, chemical manufacturing, food and beverage, and petrochemical sectors. For more information, visit us at https://nautilusenvironmental.ca/ 

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH NAUTILUS:
Wide-spanning clientele that includes industry, government, and municipalities
Opportunities to work on complex, high-level projects and to apply state-of-the-art solutions
Occasional travel to national and international conferences for professional development
Team-oriented culture with opportunities for advancement/learning & development
Health & dental benefits (vision & paramedical coverage too!)
Competitive wages, paid vacation time, and optional company-matching RRSP plan
Health & Safety is a top priority

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: There is a physical component to the position that will involve standing and/or sitting for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours).

Examples of Scope of Work (Consultant): 
Design and oversee ecotoxicity testing studies with fish, plants and invertebrates.
Schedule and coordinate testing, and review toxicity test reports.
Explore business opportunities to secure new clients and maintain/develop strong client relationships.
Identify growth opportunities through market research and technological developments.
Provide guidance and information in response to client questions and requests.
Prepare quotations and proposals.
Review or conduct statistical analysis and interpret test data.
Maintain up-to-date budgets for all managed projects.
Ensure testing is completed on time and on budget. 
Participate in invoice preparation, review and approval.
Assist/mentor Project Biologists/Project Managers with report reviews/editing.
Perform all tasks in a manner that supports Nautilus’s Quality Assurance Program. 
QUALIFICATIONS
This position requires a 1) M.Sc. in Environmental or Aquatic Toxicology, or other closely related discipline and ten (10) years of applied experience in environmental consulting; OR 2) Ph.D. in Environmental or Aquatic Toxicology, or other closely related discipline and five (5) years of applied experience in environmental consulting. Should a candidates’ qualifications exceed the listed minimums, a higher level within the consultant role, along with commensurate compensation, will be considered. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of ecotoxicology theory and practical application. The successful candidate should also be familiar with a variety of toxicity test methods, including those published by ISO, US EPA, OECD or Environment and Climate Change Canada. Knowledge of supporting analytical requirements for ecotoxicity methods (i.e., physical/chemical characteristics and other water quality aspects that influence bioavailability and bioaccumulation) is essential.  An understanding of Canadian provincial and federal regulatory requirements for ecotoxicity testing would be considered an asset.  
The successful candidate will be a creative thinker with excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.  They will also have well-developed decision-making abilities and excellent technical and scientific writing skills.  A proven track record of producing quality peer-reviewed publications or industry reports is a must. A solid understanding of applied ecotoxicology and risk assessment with demonstrated expertise in ecotoxicology/ risk assessment specific to at least one of the following areas is also a requirement: inorganic chemistry (e.g., petroleum hydrocarbons, oil sands), metal speciation chemistry (i.e., empirical knowledge and hands-on ability to use modelling software programs such as MINTEQ, WHAM, BLM), and bioavailability.
As an essential member of our team, working flexible hours may be required at times to meet project deadlines. The successful candidate must also have a willingness to work professionally in a team environment and have a commitment to high-quality output and overall team success. Occasional travel for strategic planning, business development, industry meetings, and conferences will be required (approximately 2-4 times per year).  Occasional work from home days is offered.
ACCOMMODATION: If you require an accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs. Nautilus is committed to diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  

Expected Compensation:  Dependent upon qualifications but salary range will be $85,000 – 125,000 per year.

INTERESTED? If you would like to take the next step, we want to hear from you. Interested candidates should forward their cover letter and resume quoting Consultant #2025-12 in the subject line to Sarah Gleeson:  sgleeson@nautilusenvironmental.ca

title: Vice President, Sales & Marketing - Greystone Energy Systems Inc.
description:
Where sustainability, innovation and global impact come together. Greystone Energy Systems Inc. (Greystone) has been designing and manufacturing industry-leading HVAC and building automation sensors for over 40 years, helping to create safer, smarter and more energy-efficient buildings globally. Headquartered in Moncton, New Brunswick and recognized as one of North America’s largest ISO registered manufacturers, Greystone has earned a reputation for technical excellence and as a trusted partner to OEMs, distributors, and end users worldwide. Building on decades of market leadership, Greystone is accelerating its global growth and is seeking its next Vice President, Sales & Marketing to advance expansion and lead forward-thinking strategies.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Vice President, Sales & Marketing is a key member of Greystone’s senior leadership team, accountable for shaping and executing a global strategy that drives sustainable growth. This role provides strategic oversight across North America and international markets, ensuring alignment between domestic priorities and global objectives. The VP will oversee the continued expansion of Greystone’s international sales footprint, identifying and cultivating new opportunities, developing channel partnerships, and growing a scalable sales infrastructure that supports long-term growth. They will build trusted relationships with key customers and leverage market insights to guide product development, innovation, and go-to-market strategies.

Building on Greystone’s strong foundation, the Vice President will elevate a professional, process-driven sales function while introducing forward-looking practices to position the organization for its next stage of growth. Grounded in CRM adoption, disciplined pipeline management, and accurate forecasting, they will foster a high-performance, customer-focused culture and ensure marketing strategies effectively support sales objectives and brand positioning. As a senior leader, the VP will algin sales and marketing priorities with broader organizational goals, gaining a deep understanding of the business and contributing to a collective, consensus-driven culture. By investing in team development and leading a strategic, and results-oriented group, the VP will balance internal and external priorities, drive innovation, and enhance Greystone’s market leadership.

The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of progressive sales leadership experience in building automation, HVAC, industrial instrumentation, or a related technical industry. They have led large, geographically dispersed teams often across international markets and have a proven ability to build and sustain relationships with key accounts, distribution partners, and stakeholders. A polished executive-level communicator they thrive in diverse cultural and business environments and can translate strategy into actionable plans with measurable results. Committed to team development, they are familiar with professional sales training frameworks such as Korn Ferry, Holden, or Miller Heiman. A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field is required, and an MBA or advanced executive training would be a strong asset. This role requires significant domestic and international travel (up to 30%), reflecting the global scope of the position and the VP’s engagement with key markets and customers.

title: Professional Geoscientist/Environmental Engineer
description:

Competitive salary and benefits.
Work on projects that challenge your technical skills and expand your career.

title: Policy Analyst/Analyste des politiques
location: for Climate Solutions / Fermiers pour la transition climatique Remote
description:
Farmers for Climate Solutions (FCS) is a national farmer- and rancher-led coalition advancing solutions that help the agriculture sector prosper in a changing climate. We offer peer-to-peer field programming that supports farmers and ranchers to adopt on-farm practices that build resilience and improve economic and environmental sustainability. We amplify farmer and rancher voices to policy-makers, industry, and financial institutions so that, together, we can build a future in which Canadian agriculture thrives.

FCS is seeking a Policy Analyst to help conduct policy research and analysis on climate and agriculture; to support the development of policy tools for advocacy (ex: reports, documents, briefings and surveys); to collaborate with members, partners, and the broader sector to inform policy priorities; and to provide background support for advocacy initiatives. 

Our farmer and rancher-led, solutions-oriented approach and distinct voice are helping to build bridges and shift the needle on climate change in agriculture in Canada. This is an opportunity to work with farmer and rancher leaders and partners across the country to advance policy solutions that support high resilience, low emissions farming and ranching.

Experience we are seeking 
The Policy Analyst will report to the Policy Director and will collaborate with the rest of the FCS team and with various policy advisory bodies, research task forces, and working groups. 

The information below describes the Policy Analyst, and the experience/qualifications needed to succeed in the job. If you possess approximately 80 percent of the essential experience/qualifications, we encourage you to apply.

In collaboration, conduct and coordinate policy research and analysis on agriculture and climate in Canada and abroad by:

Analyzing key government, industry, and international reports and publications on climate and agriculture, and synthesizing key findings for integration into FCS policy work
Providing relevant background and review to help inform FCS policy research task forces, advisory bodies, and working groups advancing research, policy tools, and advocacy strategies

Support sector engagement on policy priorities by:

Supporting relationships with key sector and industry partners and stakeholders on FCS policy priorities

Experience/qualifications 
ESSENTIAL 
Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and partners towards a common goal

Collaborating on the operations of the policy stream of work by:
